description.fr-FR: Lettres adressées à Bossuet par divers correspondants (Gerbais, Pirot, Pussyran et d’autres), avec un mémoire pour l’université de Douai. Édition Lachat (1864), tome XXX.
description.en-US: Letters addressed to Bossuet by various correspondents (Gerbais, Pirot, Pussyran and others), with a memorandum for the University of Douai. Lachat edition (1864), volume XXX.
description.pt-BR: Cartas dirigidas a Bossuet por diversos correspondentes (Gerbais, Pirot, Pussyran e outros), com um memorial para a universidade de Douai. Edição Lachat (1864), tomo XXX.

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais (Wayback Machine)
sources.description: Typed transcription of volume XXX, pages 016-017 (Lettres écrites à Bossuet). The transcription loses the œ ligature; it is restored by a dictionary pass (ambiguous forms such as sœur/sur, mœurs/murs, vœu/vu decided from the Lachat OCR). Page-bottom notes of the Lachat edition are kept as footnotes.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.
